patch.summary: When I Work cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: When I Work pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 14-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: When I Work cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price When I Work against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 14-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (applicant tracking, career site and job boards, workforce scheduling) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Headline list price is scheduling-only — time & attendance is a toggle not priced on the card. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Hourly teams that mainly need scheduling and messaging at a low per-user price requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
